title: 巴女谣
author: 于鹄

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 巴女谣 — 于鹄
